dedupe_keys.name: arso hydrological station data for slovenia

description: The Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO) produced this water data page, with tables and graphs from the automatic hydrological stations for surface water and groundwater, a weekly review of current and forecast hydrological conditions, a PDF of return periods of high and low flows, and archive water quality data from 2007. Coverage is Slovenia. The data are free to view online, and the return period PDF is a download. Caveats: the page offers displays, not bulk files, and it states no licence. Simulation uses: design flows and current levels for flood hazard and warning. Related records: Czech hydrology open data (data-chmi-czech-hydrology-open-data).
